customManagers.description: The minimum version of Alpine's PHP packages (etc/docker/php/Dockerfile's ARG PHP_PACKAGE_VERSION): Alpine ships PHP releases (and rebuilds) into its stable branch without an Alpine release. Looked up in that branch's package index (what apk installs from); the Check fails if this isn't the Dockerfile's Alpine branch and PHP.

packageRules.description: Prioritize runtime base images in Renovate's PR queue
Prioritize PHP package security releases (the Dockerfile's PHP_PACKAGE_VERSION) in Renovate's PR queue
Allow Node updates to advance the Alpine suffix as well
Track Exim, Alpine package revision and image build number

app/composer.json's require.php is the image's PHP minor (etc/docker/php/Dockerfile's PHP_VERSION; the Check compares them) and picks the PHP Renovate's own Composer runs on. Move it by hand with the Dockerfile.
Keep Symfony framework components on the same release line
Keep React runtime and type definitions together when a major comes (the types' minors and patches are npm build tooling, below; a group's packages share one schedule)
Built locally by Compose; this image is not published to a registry
ArtiDezi reviews and merges PRs after successful checks
Composer minor and patch updates in one PR, so lock changes don't conflict with each other. Development dependencies are grouped separately (next rule).

Composer development dependencies (require-dev: code style fixers, static analysis, the profiler) release often and the running app doesn't use them. Offer their minor and patch updates in one PR on the 1st of each month only (Renovate runs on other days leave an open one as it is). The lock may also move dependencies the app shares with them. This rule comes after the "at any time" rule above, so its schedule wins.

Composer itself (the Dockerfile's COMPOSER_VERSION) runs at build time and in checks, not in the running app. Offer its minor and patch updates on the 1st of each month only (Renovate runs on other days leave an open one as it is). This delays its security fixes too; when one matters, tick the update on the Dependency Dashboard. After the "at any time" rule above, so this schedule wins.

npm build tooling and types: minor and patch updates in one PR on 15 January and 15 July only, as devture's shared Renovate rules do elsewhere (Renovate runs on other days leave an open one as it is). When one matters sooner, tick the update on the Dependency Dashboard. React itself and the other libraries the app uses aren't restricted. After the "at any time" rule above, so this schedule wins. Lock file maintenance has its own schedule.
npm build tooling and types: major updates, a PR each, on the same two days. Not React's types, which come with React's major at any time. An open one keeps being updated.
